text: Question: Why did my recharge fail even though the amount was debited? Answer: ### Short Answer This usually happens due to a bank/payment-gateway timeout after the debit was confirmed but before NovaTel's system received acknowledgement. In most cases the recharge auto-credits within 30-60 minutes. If not credited within 24 hours, the amount is auto-reversed to source; otherwise raise a ticket with the transaction reference. ### Detailed Explanation This is a timing-gap issue, not a lost-payment issue: the bank confirms the debit before NovaTel's system registers it, so the credit normally catches up within 30-60 minutes once that acknowledgement arrives. The 24-hour auto-reversal exists specifically as the backstop for the cases where that acknowledgement never arrives at all. ### Key Details | Detail | Value | |---|---| | Typical cause | Bank/payment-gateway timeout after debit, before NovaTel acknowledgement | | Usual resolution | Auto-credit within 30-60 minutes | | If not credited within 24 hours | Amount auto-reversed to source | | If still unresolved | Raise a ticket with the transaction reference | ### Troubleshooting | Symptom | Possible Cause | Recommended Action | |---|---|---| | Amount debited, plan not credited, <1 hour elapsed | Bank/gateway acknowledgement still in transit | Wait — this is the expected window for auto-credit | | Amount debited, plan not credited, 1-24 hours elapsed | Acknowledgement delayed beyond the typical window | Continue waiting; auto-reversal triggers automatically at 24 hours if it's not resolved by then | | 24+ hours elapsed, no credit and
title: Why did my recharge fail even though the amount was debited?
